escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read & Execution
escalations.trigger: missing access control + sensitive data exposed

escalations.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS
escalations.fix: Upgrade express in platform/orchestrator to pull fixed path-to-regexp

backlog.title: Inspector scope mismatch — traceability enforcer reports false green
backlog.detail: inspector.config.yml declares source.dirs: ["Source/"] but 74 FRs live in portal/ and 10 FR-TMP-* are never scanned anywhere. CI gate reports PASSED while two specs are entirely untraced.
backlog.fix: 1) Add portal/Backend and portal/Frontend to source.dirs in inspector.config.yml. 2) Add --source-dir flag to traceability-enforcer.py. 3) Add second enforcer invocation in CLAUDE.md for portal/. 4) Document FR-TMP-* ownership.

backlog.title: Route handlers directly access store, bypassing service layer
backlog.detail: All three route files call store.* methods directly from Express handlers. CLAUDE.md mandates service layer. Makes routes untestable without touching the store.
backlog.fix: Introduce workItemService.ts wrapping workItemStore. Route handlers call service only.

backlog.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent from Source/ backend
backlog.detail: No @opentelemetry packages, no spans, no traceparent propagation. portal/ implements this correctly. FR-WF-013 (distributed tracing) unmet.
backlog.fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node and initialize in app.ts following portal/Backend/src/lib/tracing.ts pattern. Add // Verifies: FR-WF-013.

backlog.title: Tiered-merge-pipeline spec: 10/10 FRs untraced
backlog.detail: FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010 have zero traceability references in Source/ or E2E/. Likely in platform/ (solo-session territory) but ownership undocumented.
backlog.fix: Document FR-TMP-* ownership in inspector.config.yml. Either point enforcer at platform/ or explicitly note out-of-scope.

backlog.title: dependency_check_duration histogram missing from metrics.ts
backlog.detail: FR-dependency-metrics specifies 4 Prometheus metrics; dependencyCheckDuration histogram is absent. BFS cycle-detection latency unobservable.
backlog.fix: Add dependencyCheckDuration Histogram to metrics.ts. Instrument DependencyService.isReady() and detectCycle().

backlog.title: ws WebSocket protocol handler vulnerability
backlog.detail: Older ws version via dev toolchain. Resolved by upgrading vite and vitest (covered by DEP-001 and DEP-004 fixes).
backlog.cross_ref: DEP-001, DEP-004 — same upgrade resolves this

backlog.title: portal/teamDispatches route has direct DB access
backlog.detail: db.prepare().all() and db.prepare().run() called directly in route handler. All other portal routes correctly use service layer.
backlog.fix: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches() and createDispatch() methods.

backlog.title: Duplicate logger abstraction in Source/Backend
backlog.detail: Two logger modules: utils/logger.ts (canonical) and logger.ts (shim). Confuses import paths; shim is a coordination workaround, not a design decision.
backlog.fix: Pick utils/logger.ts as the only logger. Update all callers. Delete the shim.

backlog.title: eslint-disable suppressing hook exhaustive-deps without rationale
backlog.detail: Two eslint-disable comments suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without inline justification. Hidden lint debt.
backlog.fix: Add rationale comment to each suppression. Consider useCallback/useMemo to eliminate need.

backlog.title: Jest ecosystem moderate CVEs (multiple packages)
backlog.detail: 24+ moderate CVEs in Jest ecosystem via @babel/core, @istanbuljs, babel-plugin-istanbul, jest-snapshot, jest-runner, etc. Dev/test environment only.
backlog.fix: Upgrade jest to ^30.x. Run full test suite after upgrade.

backlog.title: express & qs parameter pollution (moderate)
backlog.detail: qs parsing allows query parameter pollution attacks via older express versions. Medium impact depending on query param handling.
backlog.fix: Upgrade express to ^4.22.2 in Backend and Orchestrator.

backlog.title: uuid outdated 5 major versions behind
backlog.detail: uuid@9.0.0 installed; latest is 14.0.1. Functional but indicates dependency drift.
backlog.fix: npm install uuid@^14.0.0 in Source/Backend. Update @types/uuid.

backlog.title: esbuild & postcss moderate CVEs via dev toolchain
backlog.detail: esbuild CORS bypass (resolved by vite upgrade). postcss XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS output. Dev toolchain only.
backlog.fix: Upgrade vite@^5.5.0 resolves esbuild. postcss: upgrade separately if XSS is a CI risk.

backlog.title: Spec regex false-positive on data entity IDs FR-0004, FR-0007
backlog.detail: Seed data description uses FR-0004 and FR-0007 as database record IDs. Enforcer regex matches them as missing spec requirements (2 false positives).
backlog.fix: Wrap seed data IDs in backticks or add a note distinguishing them from requirement IDs.

backlog.title: pino & uuid minor outdated versions
backlog.detail: pino@8.x (latest 10.x, 2 major behind). prom-client at latest patch. Minor drift, no known security impact.
backlog.fix: Upgrade pino@^10.x with breaking-change testing. prom-client: no action needed.

cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves protobufjs RCE (P1) and gRPC crash (P2) in one operation

cross_reference_map.single_fix: npm install vitest@^3.2.6 vite@^5.5.0 in Source/Frontend
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves Vitest RCE (P1), Vite CORS bypass (P2), ws vuln (P2), esbuild CORS (P3) in one PR

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Service layer pattern not enforced in route handlers
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add lint rule enforcing no db.* or store.* calls in routes/; introduce service objects for workItems and teamDispatches
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves architecture violations in Source/Backend (P2) and portal/Backend (P3)

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Extend inspector.config.yml source.dirs and add portal/ + FR-TMP-* enforcement
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves false-green P1 enforcement gate and untraced TMP spec (P2) together
